name: Shin Hyun-been
bio:
Shin Hyun-been (신현빈) is a South Korean actress born on April 10, 1986. A graduate of the Korea National University of Arts with a degree in Art Theory, she made her acting debut in the feature film He's on Duty (2010), earning Best New Actress at the 47th Baeksang Arts Awards.

She achieved breakout success as Dr. Jang Gyeo-ul in Hospital Playlist (2020–2021). Her lead drama credits include Reflection of You (2021), Monstrous (2022), Reborn Rich (2022), Tell Me That You Love Me (2023–2024), and Cinderella at 2 AM (2024). Film credits include Confidential Assignment (2017) and Beasts Clawing at Straws (2020).

credits.overview: A story about a public servant whose only hobby is growing plants, and due to a sudden massive debt, teams up with the neighborhood troublemaker to dive into a unique gardening business, causing the quiet town to spiral into unimaginable chaos.

credits.title: The Assassin(s)
credits.overview: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
